facts.fact: The Presidency's release says the unique-identifier enrolment, launched 11 November 2026, is run by the ministry in charge of digital transition, with everything done by Burkinabè engineers and Burkina's public bodies.
President Traoré says the identifier system is purely Burkinabè, made by Burkinabè engineers and public bodies, with data hosting centres in Burkina Faso.

systems.owner: Ministry in charge of digital transition

note: Who maintains the system after launch is not stated.
